name: security-tekton-task-run-authority-review
intent: Tekton TaskRun parameters, workspaces and execution identity
artifacts: Task/Pipeline references, resolvers, TaskRun writers, service accounts, workspaces and pod templates.
trace: Trace lower-trust parameters or remotely resolved task content into a workload with privileged credentials, volumes or service identity.
experiment: Use an isolated cluster task with inert output; compare permitted parameter use and a forbidden task/workspace/service-account selection.
disproof: Task expressiveness is not escalation if only an appropriately trusted operator may create the run.
repair: Constrain task sources and run authority, preserving approved parameterization and workspace isolation.
branch_decisions: Resolve referenced Task/ClusterTask/bundle content, admitted service account, workspace/PVC mounts and parameter substitution into executable steps. A parameter appearing in a script is different from an argv element. The TaskRun submitter may intentionally hold deployment authority; show where the actual restricted submitter can borrow a stronger execution identity.
